# Wire format

Every row is `?v=<query>` for a param named `v`. An empty query means the param is omitted.

| Codec | Input | Query string |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `c.string()` | `'hello'` | `v=hello` |
| `c.string()` | `'a b & c'` | `v=a+b+%26+c` |
| `c.string()` | `'日本語'` | `v=%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC%E8%AA%9E` |
| `c.string()` | `'a,b'` | `v=a,b` |
| `c.string()` | `'' (equals default)` | _(omitted)_ |
| `c.integer()` | `42` | `v=42` |
| `c.integer()` | `-7` | `v=-7` |
| `c.float()` | `1.5` | `v=1.5` |
| `c.float()` | `-0` | `v=-0` |
| `c.float()` | `NaN` | `v=NaN` |
| `c.float()` | `Infinity` | `v=Infinity` |
| `c.boolean()` | `true` | `v=true` |
| `c.boolean()` | `false` | `v=false` |
| `c.enum([...])` | `'name'` | `v=name` |
| `c.array(c.string())` | `['a', 'b']` | `v=a,b` |
| `c.array(c.string())` | `['a,b']` | `v=a%252Cb` |
| `c.array(c.string())` | `['a%2Cb']` | `v=a%25252Cb` |
| `c.array(c.string())` | `['']` | `v=` |
| `c.array(c.string())` | `[] (empty)` | _(omitted)_ |
| `c.array(c.integer())` | `[1, 2, 3]` | `v=1,2,3` |
| `c.array(c.string(), { mode: 'repeat' })` | `['a', 'b']` | `v=a&v=b` |
| `c.array(c.string(), { sep: '|' })` | `['a', 'b']` | `v=a%7Cb` |
| `c.isoDate()` | `new Date(0)` | `v=1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z` |
| `c.timestamp()` | `new Date(0)` | `v=0` |
| `c.json()` | `{ a: 1, b: [2] }` | `v=%7B%22a%22:1,%22b%22:%5B2%5D%7D` |
| `c.numberRange()` | `[10, 250]` | `v=10,250` |
| `c.numberRange()` | `[-5, 10]` | `v=-5,10` |
